identity.name: Aquis Calibre 400 Date
identity.one_liner: The Aquis dive watch with Oris's first in-house 5-day automatic caliber — the movement that moved Oris from base-Sellita to a true manufacture.

narrative.story: The Calibre 400, launched in 2020, is Oris's first in-house automatic movement in a generation: a 120-hour (5-day) power reserve, anti-magnetic to 2,250 gauss, and a 10-year service interval. The Aquis case — 41.5mm with the trademark integrated crown protector — had been Oris's flagship diver since 2011. The Calibre 400 replaced the Sellita-based Oris 733 inside it. The Aquis Calibre 400 is the most-cited modern Oris and the watch that re-positioned the brand from a Sellita-base house to a credible independent manufacture.
narrative.collector_notes: The Calibre 400 is a true manufacture movement designed in-house. Earlier Aquis models used the Sellita SW200-1-based Oris 733 — check the caseback marking.
